units.rawText: I started out in the Burbank Sector, but back then, it wasn't the lively place it is now. It was so dull and lifeless. I left quickly because I didn't believe I could find any inspiration in that place.

units.rawText: Yep, I missed meeting her. When I heard about the Oasis, I figured I'd give it a shot and move in. At first, I was all about finding some kind of excitement to spark some inspiration... But honestly, the whole chasing and running to get here was already too thrilling.
